summary_en: Studies how hemispherical transducer-array sampling geometry affects baseline 3D PACT reconstruction quality under fixed hardware constraints. A uniform-spacing design framework is used to compare representative layouts across noise, reduced-element, static, and rotational acquisition regimes, with Fibonacci sampling showing the most globally balanced structural robustness.
